Welcome to the YouTube Channel for Pressure Point Sports Massage Training.
I specialise in Sports Massage, deep tissue techniques for the whole body with a particular interest in back massage and anatomy.  I teach VTCT sports massage from Level 3 to Level 5 which includes gait analysis, neuro-spinal assessment, palpation techniques, advanced anatomy, orthopaedic techniques, postural assessment and joint range of movement at my clinic in Arnold, Nottingham (UK).  

I have just released my first book "Your Journey to Massage Confidence: From First Client to Established Practice" available on Amazon:  https://amzn.eu/d/01mBEqe6 

Pressure Point Training also delivers a range of accredited Sports Massage, acupuncture, rehab, anatomy and holistic courses. All courses are available as face to face delivery at our training centre such as reflexology, pregnancy massage, , hot stone #massage , taping, #anatomy , manual lymphatic drainage, fire cupping and rehabilitation.
